user_problem: Teams need a draft mapping from supplied document types to existing retention labels without moving or deleting files.
unique_output: A label map with document type, defining cues, assigned supplied label, conflict, exclusion, and manual-review case.
required_input: Document-type definitions, approved retention labels, mapping rules, exclusions, and synthetic file descriptions.
critical_rule: Do not infer legal requirements, inspect files, or delete content; unresolved classifications require manual review.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is taxonomy-gap-finder; this maps operational document types to supplied retention labels rather than finding taxonomy coverage gaps.
acceptance_scenario: Input labels Project-3Y and Permanent; rule maps signed charters to Permanent and drafts to Project-3Y. Output classifies 'signed charter v1' as Permanent and flags 'charter notes' because draft status is unstated.
